script: I spent three years building the perfect productivity system
busy, sure, organized technically, but not moving
It was stripping back to seven small habits
It happened at the end of the day
My shutdown ritual takes four minutes
suddenly realizing that I hadn't actually heard the last few minutes
our brains fixate on unfinished work until we register closure
I spend 20 minutes writing down everything that is in my head
my brain had become a browser with fifty tabs open

Getting information out of your head and onto paper frees up capacity
Do your most dreaded tasks first, but only one frog
then I would have a frog festival and wonder why
To-do lists create a permanent state of deficit
one 90-minute block of deep work per day
The first 15 to 20 minutes of any focus session are transitional
write exactly three priorities for tomorrow
Start with one. The one that stings a little when you read it
